title: End of the reel and pleasantries
summary: The interviewer notes the reel is nearly out and the group chats before stopping.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: I'm just about out of this reel here if you feel like going another half hour. I can go as long as you want to go. Alright, unless you're worn out. We don't want to make you get tired. Tired?
Not keeping you from your supper, are we? Huh? Not keeping you from your supper?

No, indeed. I don't. Y'all want a cold drink? I don't believe so unless you do that. Thank you very much. We just stopped on the way over and had some root beer. I wonder what happened to Harold. He must be pulling out his teeth. Oh. Oh. Mm-hm.
